observations: Matched sheets show maintained grasp/lift, two snips and extraction in both recordings. Local neck/cut shapes and grasper opening differ during snips; whole-trajectory plot shows an appreciable first-snip jaw-gap difference.

Baseline/candidate first-snip mean jaw gap: 3.0703 / 1.9552 mm. Second-snip tumor RMS speed peak: 32.8386 / 27.6239 mm/s; hold peak: 0.7853 / 0.1620 mm/s. These are descriptive differences, not realism pass criteria.
Fresh baselines from the two experiment sequences also differ: first-snip mean jaw gap 2.0895 vs 3.0703 mm. No cause for this repeat variability is established.
All 1111 states are preserved in the videos and read in motion statistics. Visual inspection covers the listed sheets and full plot; not a claim that every video pixel was manually inspected.
Both quality reports remain false, and normal timing gives no reliable gain, including an unexplained post-cut slow run. Not adopted.
